Home / Loading-States / Progress Bar

Progress Bar

A visual indicator showing the completion progress of a task or process.

Basic Progress Bar

A simple progress bar showing completion level.

HTML
<div class="zak-progress">
    <div class="zak-progress-bar" style="width:45%"></div>
</div>

Progress with Label

Add a text label inside the progress bar.

60%
HTML
<div class="zak-progress">
    <div class="zak-progress-bar" style="width:60%">60%</div>
</div>

Progress with Percentage Text

Show the percentage as a label above or beside the bar.

Upload Progress 75%
HTML
<div class="zak-progress-wrapper">
    <div class="zak-progress-header">
        <span>Upload Progress</span>
        <span>75%</span>
    </div>
    <div class="zak-progress">
        <div class="zak-progress-bar" style="width:75%"></div>
    </div>
</div>

Color Variants

Use color classes to convey different statuses.

HTML
<div class="zak-progress">
    <div class="zak-progress-bar zak-progress-primary" style="width:70%"></div>
</div>

<div class="zak-progress">
    <div class="zak-progress-bar zak-progress-success" style="width:85%"></div>
</div>

<div class="zak-progress">
    <div class="zak-progress-bar zak-progress-danger" style="width:25%"></div>
</div>

<div class="zak-progress">
    <div class="zak-progress-bar zak-progress-warning" style="width:55%"></div>
</div>

<div class="zak-progress">
    <div class="zak-progress-bar zak-progress-info" style="width:40%"></div>
</div>

Striped Progress

Add diagonal stripes for a styled appearance.

HTML
<div class="zak-progress">
    <div class="zak-progress-bar zak-progress-striped" style="width:65%"></div>
</div>

Animated Stripes

Combine stripes with animation for an active progress effect.

HTML
<div class="zak-progress">
    <div class="zak-progress-bar zak-progress-striped zak-progress-animated" style="width:60%"></div>
</div>

Stacked Progress Bars

Combine multiple bars to show multi-step progress.

35%
25%
15%
HTML
<div class="zak-progress">
    <div class="zak-progress-bar zak-progress-success" style="width:35%">35%</div>
    <div class="zak-progress-bar zak-progress-info" style="width:25%">25%</div>
    <div class="zak-progress-bar zak-progress-warning" style="width:15%">15%</div>
</div>

Progress with Icon

Add an icon alongside the progress bar for context.

Uploading files 3 of 5
HTML
<div class="zak-progress-wrapper">
    <div class="zak-progress-header">
        <span>Uploading files</span>
        <span>3 of 5</span>
    </div>
    <div class="zak-progress">
        <div class="zak-progress-bar zak-progress-striped zak-progress-animated zak-progress-primary" style="width:60%"></div>
    </div>
</div>

Heights

Control the thickness of the progress bar.

HTML
<div class="zak-progress zak-progress-thin">
    <div class="zak-progress-bar" style="width:70%"></div>
</div>

<div class="zak-progress">
    <div class="zak-progress-bar" style="width:55%"></div>
</div>

<div class="zak-progress zak-progress-thick">
    <div class="zak-progress-bar" style="width:40%"></div>
</div>

CSS Variables

HTML
:root {
    --zak-progress-height: 0.75rem;
    --zak-progress-bg: var(--zak-surface-alt);
    --zak-progress-bar-bg: var(--zak-primary);
    --zak-progress-radius: 9999px;
    --zak-progress-transition: width 0.3s ease;
}

.zak-progress-thin { --zak-progress-height: 0.25rem; }
.zak-progress-thick { --zak-progress-height: 1.5rem; }
